purification_method: washed with 2 mol/L HCl, rinsed with deionized water to neutral pH, dried at 80 C for 12 h

source_location: main-06 (p. 24032) Fig. 4e, NHPC-3 solid (adsorption) markers; volumetric: main-07 (p. 24033) Fig. 5c, NHPC-3 (matched by pressure)
